descriptionByLocale.en:
# Senior HR Business Partner – Corporate Functions (Switzerland) ## The Opportunity At Hitachi Energy, our purpose is **Inspiring the Next through building a sustainable energy future**. We power homes, schools, hospitals and industries—and it's our people who make that possible. We are seeking an experienced HR Business Partner to support our Corporate Functions in Switzerland. This is a highly operational, hands-on role in a complex, global matrix environment. ## Mansioni - Act as a key HR contact for Corporate Function leaders for employees based in Switzerland, providing practical, day-to-day support - Ensure effective HR operations across the employee lifecycle, delivered consistently and in line with policy - Guide stakeholders through complex HR topics, connecting them with the right Centres of Excellence (CoEs) and HR experts - Collaborate closely with global HRBPs, CoEs, and specialist teams to deliver integrated solutions - Build trusted relationships with multiple senior stakeholders, balancing perspectives and priorities - Apply strong political awareness and organisational understanding to navigate sensitive topics effectively - Ensure full compliance with Swiss employment legislation and local regulatory requirements - Work confidently with works councils/employee representative bodies - Support delivery of talent, performance, and organisational processes in partnership with HR colleagues - Use data and insight to support pragmatic, solution-oriented decision-making - Foster a culture of collaboration, transparency, and shared accountability across HR ##
• Requisiti - 8+ years' relevant HR experience, including operating at HRBP level within a multinational, matrix organisation - Excellent knowledge of Swiss employment legislation and local HR practices (essential), including German language fluency - Experience working with works councils/employee representatives - Proven ability to manage multiple senior stakeholders in a complex environment - Comfortable working within a CoE model, partnering with global HRBP communities and shared services - Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with a pragmatic and solution-focused mindset - High level of political awareness and ability to navigate organisational complexity - Collaborative approach—able to connect people, teams, and expertise to resolve issues effectively - Experience supporting Corporate Functions or similarly structured environments is advantageous ##
• Cosa offriamo - Join a purpose-driven organisation shaping the future of sustainable energy - Work in a truly global and collaborative HR environment - Be part of a team that values diversity, transparency, and continuous improvement - Gain exposure to complex, high-impact organisational challenges - Develop your career within a leading international organisation ## Note importante - This is an operational HRBP role, focused on delivery and execution rather than strategic design - You must have the right to work in Switzerland - Relocation support is not provided for this position

title: Engineering Global Sustainability Leader
location: Remote - North Carolina, United States of America

descriptionByLocale.it:
The opportunity Sustainability starts at the design table—and this role puts you right at the center of that impact. As the Engineering Design Sustainability Lead , you will shape how sustainability is embedded into global engineering decisions across our transformer business. This is a highly visible, strategic role where engineering excellence meets environmental responsibility. You will lead the shift from downstream sustainability activities to design‑led outcomes, ensuring product‑level carbon reduction, material optimization, and environmental performance are built into every design choice from the outset. You will work across global engineering teams to translate sustainability ambitions into measurable, auditable product outcomes—balancing cost, safety, quality, and performance. With increasing expectations from customers, regulators, and stakeholders for credible product‑level data, your work will directly support compliance, ESG reporting, and long‑term business resilience. If you thrive at the intersection of engineering, data, and sustainability—and enjoy influencing without direct authority—this role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of sustainable product design at scale. How you'll make an impact Define and drive a global, design‑led sustainability strategy within Engineering. Embed sustainability into engineering standards, processes, and decision frameworks. Reduce product‑level carbon footprint through smart design, material, and architecture choices. Establish sustainability targets, KPIs, and traceable product‑level data at BOM level. Partner across engineering, R&D, supply chain, digital and operations teams globally. Strengthen governance, reporting, and audit‑ready sustainability metrics. Build capability and foster ownership of sustainable design within engineering teams. Translate regulatory and customer sustainability expectations into engineering requirements. Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Your background Master's degree or PhD in Engineering or a closely related sustainability discipline. 10+ years of engineering experience, including 5+ years in sustainability‑focused roles. Proven success delivering design‑led sustainability or product carbon reduction initiatives. Strong knowledge of lifecycle assessment, sustainable materials, and carbon accounting. Experience leading global, cross‑functional initiatives and influencing senior stakeholders. Strong analytical mindset with a data‑driven approach to decision‑making. More about us At Hitachi Energy , sustainability, innovation, and safety are core to how we design the future of energy. You'll work in a global, diverse environment where ideas are valued and impact is visible.
• We offer meaningful opportunities to grow, lead, and shape industry‑leading solutions with purpose.

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione La nostra Grid Integration – GPQSS (azienda di integrazione del sistema AC) sta cercando un Leader di Marketing e Vendite globale per modellare, accelerare ed eseguire la nostra strategia commerciale mondiale. Questo ruolo strategico senior richiede un esecutivo di vendite realizzato in grado di guidare la crescita redditizia, rafforzare la nostra presenza di mercato, e leader team globali ad alto rendimento all'interno di una complessa matrice organizzazione. In qualità di Executive Sales & Marketing Manager, possederai la strategia commerciale a lungo termine e la sua esecuzione operativa per il Global Product Group, impostando la visione e gli obiettivi di vendita globali, garantendo un'efficace distribuzione in paesi e segmenti. Sarete responsabili di fornire obiettivi ambiziosi di crescita, di margine e di espansione del mercato in allineamento con la strategia di Marketing & Sales dell'unità aziendale. Come membro chiave del team di leadership globale, collaborerai a stretto contatto con la gestione dei prodotti, lo sviluppo aziendale, le operazioni, le finanze e i leader regionali, e rappresenterai il business di Hitachi Energy Grid and Power Quality Solutions and Service in senior customer engagement, forum industriali e partnership strategiche, posizionando l'organizzazione come leader tecnologico di fiducia. Come farai ad avere un impatto - Condurre lo sviluppo e l'esecuzione della strategia commerciale globale per il business GPQSS, stabilire una chiara visione a lungo termine, traducendola in piani di vendita a livello nazionale e specifici per segmenti che consentono una crescita coerente e scalabile in tutto il mondo. - Definire e possedere l'ambizione di vendita globale, tra cui ricavi, margini e obiettivi di espansione del mercato, assicurando che gli obiettivi di vendita non siano allineati solo con la strategia di Marketing & Sales della Business Unit, ma anche sostenuti da insight basati sui dati, posizionamento competitivo e tendenze dei clienti emergenti. - Promuovere una crescita proficua in tutte le regioni organizzando un approccio unificato di go-to-market, rafforzando la qualità delle tubazioni, migliorando la precisione delle previsioni e garantendo una gestione delle prestazioni commerciali disciplinata in una struttura di matrice complessa. - Elevate la presenza globale di mercato di Hitachi Energy's Grid and Power Quality Solutions & Services, posizionando il portafoglio come punto di riferimento del settore attraverso l'intelligenza di mercato mirata, le proposte differenziate di valore e le attività di leader di pensiero che rafforzano la nostra reputazione come leader tecnologico di fiducia. - Guidare, ispirare e sviluppare team di vendita e marketing globali ad alto rendimento, incorporando una cultura di responsabilità, collaborazione e eccellenza commerciale, fornendo ai team strumenti, formazione e strutture necessarie per eseguire in scala. - Agire come partner strategico per le principali parti interessate interne, tra cui gestione del prodotto, sviluppo aziendale, operazioni, finanza e leadership regionale, garantendo un allineamento stretto tra strategia commerciale, priorità roadmap del prodotto, capacità di consegna e obiettivi di performance aziendali. - Rappresentare l'azienda ai massimi livelli di impegno del cliente e dell'industria, costruire e nutrire relazioni esecutive, negoziare leader, e influenzare gli organismi del settore, alleanze strategiche e partner ecosistemici per far progredire la leadership di Hitachi Energy nell'integrazione della rete e nella qualità della potenza. - Guidare l'allineamento interfunzionale per accelerare la penetrazione del mercato, assicurando un coordinamento senza soluzione di continuità tra vendite, marketing, tendering, servizio e operazioni per massimizzare i tassi di vincita, ottimizzare le strategie di prezzi e migliorare il valore del cliente attraverso il ciclo di vita. - Superare i quadri di governance commerciale e le metriche di performance, assicurando che le attività di vendita globali siano eseguite in modo coerente, etico ed efficiente, e che il rigoroso monitoraggio delle prestazioni supporti il miglioramento continuo e l'agilità strategica. - L'innovazione del campione e le intuizioni di mercato, l'alimentazione del cliente, il concorrente e l'intelligenza di mercato nell'organizzazione per modellare le strategie future del prodotto, guidare le decisioni di investimento e identificare nuove opportunità di crescita.
descriptionByLocale.en: ## Descrizione The opportunity Our Grid Integration – GPQSS (AC system integration business) is seeking a global Marketing and Sales Leader to shape, accelerate, and execute our worldwide commercial strategy. This senior strategic role requires an accomplished sales executive capable of driving profitable growth, strengthening our market presence, and leading high-performing global teams within a complex matrix organization. As the Executive Sales & Marketing Manager, you will own the long-term commercial strategy and its operational execution for the Global Product Group, setting the global sales vision and targets while ensuring effective deployment across countries and segments. You will be responsible for delivering ambitious growth, margin, and market-expansion objectives in alignment with the Business Unit's Marketing & Sales strategy. As a key member of the global leadership team, you will collaborate closely with Product Management, Business Development, Operations, Finance, and regional leaders, and you will represent Hitachi Energy's Grid and Power Quality Solutions and Service business in senior customer engagements, industry forums, and strategic partnerships, positioning the organization as a trusted technology leader. ## How you'll make an impact - Lead the development and execution of the global commercial strategy for the GPQSS business, establishing a clear long-term vision while translating it into actionable, country-level and segment-specific sales plans that enable consistent, scalable growth worldwide. - Define and own the global sales ambition, including revenue, margin, and market-expansion targets, ensuring that sales objectives are not only aligned with the Business Unit's Marketing & Sales strategy but also underpinned by data-driven insights, competitive positioning, and emerging customer trends. - Drive profitable growth across all regions by orchestrating a unified go-to-market approach, strengthening pipeline quality, enhancing forecasting precision, and ensuring disciplined commercial performance management across a complex matrix structure. - Elevate the global market presence of Hitachi Energy's Grid and Power Quality Solutions & Services, positioning the portfolio as the industry benchmark through targeted market intelligence, differentiated value propositions, and thought-leadership activities that reinforce our reputation as a trusted technology leader. - Lead, inspire, and develop high-performing global sales and marketing teams, embedding a culture of accountability, collaboration, and commercial excellence while equipping teams with the tools, training, and structures they need to execute at scale. - Act as a strategic partner to key internal stakeholders, including Product Management, Business Development, Operations, Finance, and regional leadership, ensuring tight alignment between commercial strategy, product roadmap priorities, delivery capabilities, and business performance objectives. - Represent the business at the highest levels in customer and industry engagements, building and nurturing executive relationships, leading negotiations, and influencing industry bodies, strategic alliances, and ecosystem partners to advance Hitachi Energy's leadership in grid integration and power quality. - Drive cross-functional alignment to accelerate market penetration, ensuring seamless coordination between sales, marketing, tendering, service, and operations to maximize win rates, optimize pricing strategies, and enhance customer value across the lifecycle. - Oversee commercial governance frameworks and performance metrics, ensuring that global sales activities are executed consistently, ethically, and efficiently, and that rigorous performance tracking supports continuous improvement and strategic agility. - Champion innovation and market-back insights, feeding customer, competitor, and market intelligence into the organization to shape future product strategies, guide investment decisions, and identify new growth opportunities.
descriptionByLocale.de: Beschreibung Die Chance Unsere Grid Integration – GPQSS (AC-Systemintegrationsgeschäft) sucht einen globalen Marketing- und Vertriebsleiter, um unsere weltweite Handelsstrategie zu gestalten, zu beschleunigen und umzusetzen. Diese hochrangige strategische Rolle erfordert eine erfolgreiche Vertriebsleitung, die in der Lage ist, profitables Wachstum zu erzielen, unsere Marktpräsenz zu stärken und führende hochperformierende globale Teams innerhalb einer komplexen Matrixorganisation zu führen. Als Executive Sales & Marketing Manager besitzen Sie die langfristige kommerzielle Strategie und ihre operative Umsetzung für die Global Product Group und setzen dabei die globale Verkaufsvision und -ziele fest und gewährleisten einen effektiven Einsatz in Ländern und Segmenten. Sie werden dafür verantwortlich sein, ambitionierte Wachstums-, Margen- und Marktexpansionsziele im Einklang mit der Marketing- und Vertriebsstrategie des Unternehmens zu erreichen. Als zentrales Mitglied des globalen Führungsteams werden Sie eng mit Product Management, Business Development, Operations, Finance und regionalen Führungskräften zusammenarbeiten und das Unternehmen Grid and Power Quality Solutions and Service von Hitachi Energy in Senior Customer Engagements, Branchenforen und strategischen Partnerschaften vertreten und die Organisation als vertrauenswürdiger Technologieführer positionieren. Wie Sie einen Einfluss haben - Führen Sie die Entwicklung und Umsetzung der globalen kommerziellen Strategie für das GPQSS-Geschäft, die Schaffung einer klaren langfristigen Vision und die Umsetzung in handlungsfähige, landesweite und segmentspezifische Vertriebspläne, die ein konsequentes, skalierbares Wachstum weltweit ermöglichen. - Definieren und besitzen Sie den globalen Umsatz-Ehrgeiz, einschließlich Umsatz-, Margen- und Marktexpansions-Ziele, um sicherzustellen, dass die Verkaufsziele nicht nur mit der Marketing- und Vertriebsstrategie der Business Unit vereinbar sind, sondern auch durch datengetriebene Erkenntnisse, wettbewerbsfähige Positionierung und aufstrebende Kundentrends untermauert werden. - Fahren Sie profitables Wachstum in allen Regionen, indem Sie einen einheitlichen Go-to-Market-Ansatz orchestrieren, die Pipeline-Qualität stärken, die Prognosegenauigkeit verbessern und diszipliniertes kommerzielles Leistungsmanagement über eine komplexe Matrixstruktur gewährleisten. - Erhöhen Sie die globale Marktpräsenz von Hitachi Energy's Grid and Power Quality Solutions & Services und positionieren Sie das Portfolio als Branchen-Benchmark durch gezielte Marktinformationen, differenzierte Wertvorstellungen und durchdachte Führungsaktivitäten, die unseren Ruf als vertrauenswürdiger Technologieführer stärken. - Führen, inspirieren und entwickeln leistungsstarke globale Vertriebs- und Marketingteams, die eine Kultur der Rechenschaftspflicht, Zusammenarbeit und kommerziellen Exzellenz einbetten und Teams mit Werkzeugen, Schulungen und Strukturen ausrüsten, die sie im Maßstab ausführen müssen. - Handeln Sie als strategischer Partner für wichtige interne Interessenvertreter, einschließlich Product Management, Business Development, Operations, Finanzen und regionale Führung, um eine enge Abstimmung zwischen kommerzieller Strategie, Produkt-Roadmap-Prioritäten, Lieferfähigkeiten und Geschäftsleistungszielen sicherzustellen. - Repräsentieren Sie das Geschäft auf höchstem Niveau in Kunden- und Industrieengagements, Aufbau und Pflege von Führungsbeziehungen, führenden Verhandlungen und Einfluss auf Branchengremien, strategische Allianzen und Ökosystem-Partner, um die Führung von Hitachi Energy bei der Netzintegration und -qualität zu fördern. - Führen Sie die funktionsübergreifende Ausrichtung aus, um die Marktdurchdringung zu beschleunigen, eine nahtlose Abstimmung zwischen Vertrieb, Marketing, Angebot, Service und Betrieb sicherzustellen, um die Gewinnraten zu maximieren, Preisstrategien zu optimieren und den Kundenwert über den gesamten Lebenszyklus zu steigern. - Beaufsichtigen Sie kommerzielle Governance-Frameworks und Performance Metriken, um sicherzustellen, dass globale Vertriebsaktivitäten konsequent, ethisch und effizient ausgeführt werden und dass strenge Performance Tracking kontinuierliche Verbesserung und strategische Agilität unterstützt. - Championinnovation und Marktrückblicke, Fütterung von Kunden, Wettbewerbern und Marktinformationen in die Organisation, um zukünftige Produktstrategien zu gestalten, Investitionsentscheidungen zu führen und neue Wachstumschancen zu identifizieren.
descriptionByLocale.fr: Descrizione L'opportunité Notre intégration Grid – GPQSS (AC system integration business) cherche un leader mondial du marketing et des ventes pour façonner, accélérer et exécuter notre stratégie commerciale mondiale. Ce rôle stratégique de haut niveau nécessite un cadre commercial accompli capable de stimuler une croissance rentable, de renforcer notre présence sur le marché et de diriger des équipes mondiales à haut rendement au sein d'une organisation matricielle complexe. En tant que responsable des ventes et du marketing, vous serez propriétaire de la stratégie commerciale à long terme et de son exécution opérationnelle pour le Groupe de produits mondial, en définissant la vision et les objectifs des ventes mondiales tout en assurant un déploiement efficace à travers les pays et les segments. Vous serez responsable de la réalisation d'objectifs ambitieux de croissance, de marge et d'expansion du marché, conformément à la stratégie de marketing et de vente de l'unité commerciale. En tant que membre clé de l'équipe de direction mondiale, vous collaborerez étroitement avec la gestion des produits, le développement des affaires, les opérations, les finances et les dirigeants régionaux, et vous représenterez l'activité Grid and Power Quality Solutions and Service d'Hitachi Energy dans les relations avec les clients, les forums de l'industrie et les partenariats stratégiques. Comment vous ferez un impact - Diriger l ' élaboration et la mise en œuvre de la stratégie commerciale mondiale pour les activités du GPQSS, en établissant une vision claire à long terme tout en la traduisant en plans de vente réalisables au niveau des pays et spécifiques à chaque segment, qui permettent une croissance cohérente et évolutive dans le monde entier. - Définir et posséder l'ambition des ventes mondiales, y compris les revenus, la marge et les objectifs d'expansion du marché, en veillant à ce que les objectifs des ventes ne soient pas seulement alignés sur la stratégie marketing et des ventes de l'unité commerciale, mais également étayés par des informations basées sur les données, un positionnement concurrentiel et de nouvelles tendances clientes. - Favoriser une croissance rentable dans toutes les régions en orchestrant une approche unifiée de l'accès au marché, en renforçant la qualité des pipelines, en améliorant la précision des prévisions et en assurant une gestion des performances commerciales disciplinées dans une structure matricielle complexe. - Augmenter la présence sur le marché mondial des solutions et services Grid and Power Quality d'Hitachi Energy, positionner le portefeuille en tant que référence de l'industrie grâce à une intelligence de marché ciblée, à des propositions de valeur différenciées et à des activités de réflexion qui renforcent notre réputation de leader technologique de confiance. - Diriger, inspirer et développer des équipes de vente et de marketing mondial hautement performantes, intégrer une culture de responsabilité, de collaboration et d'excellence commerciale tout en équipant les équipes des outils, de la formation et des structures dont elles ont besoin pour exécuter à l'échelle. - Agir en tant que partenaire stratégique pour les principaux intervenants internes, y compris la gestion des produits, le développement des affaires, les opérations, les finances et le leadership régional, en assurant l'harmonisation étroite entre la stratégie commerciale, les priorités de la feuille de route des produits, les capacités de prestation et les objectifs de rendement opérationnel. - Représenter les entreprises aux plus hauts niveaux dans les engagements des clients et de l'industrie, établir et entretenir des relations avec les cadres supérieurs, diriger les négociations et influencer les organismes de l'industrie, les alliances stratégiques et les partenaires écosystémiques pour faire progresser le leadership d'Hitachi Energy dans l'intégration du réseau et la qualité de l'énergie. - Conduire l'alignement interfonctionnel pour accélérer la pénétration du marché, assurer une coordination transparente entre les ventes, le marketing, l'appel d'offres, le service et les opérations afin de maximiser les taux de réussite, d'optimiser les stratégies de tarification et d'améliorer la valeur du client tout au long du cycle de vie. - Superviser les cadres de gouvernance commerciale et les indicateurs de performance, en veillant à ce que les activités de vente mondiales soient exécutées de façon cohérente, éthique et efficace, et à ce que le suivi rigoureux des performances favorise l'amélioration continue et l'agilité stratégique. - Championne l'innovation et les perspectives de marché, alimente la clientèle, les concurrents et l'intelligence du marché dans l'organisation pour façonner les stratégies futures de produits, orienter les décisions d'investissement et identifier de nouvelles possibilités de croissance.

If you are passionate about driving market expansion, enabling high‑performing sales teams, and building a strong partner ecosystem for innovative power conversion solutions, this role offers you the opportunity to make a significant impact across Europe. We want you to truly thrive with us, in work and out.
descriptionByLocale.de: Die Gelegenheit Wir suchen einen zukunftsorientierten Business Development & Sales Enablement Manager für PCS (Power Conversion Systems), um unser Wachstum auf dem europäischen Markt zu beschleunigen. In dieser strategischen Rolle verbinden Sie unsere GPG-Vertriebsteams, regionalen Marktmanager und die Front-End-Vertriebsorganisation (FES) und stellen so eine vollständige Ausrichtung auf unsere Markteinführungsstrategie sicher und stärken gleichzeitig unsere kommerzielle Präsenz. Wenn Sie leidenschaftlich daran interessiert sind, die Marktexpansion voranzutreiben, leistungsstarke Vertriebsteams zu unterstützen und ein starkes Partner-Ökosystem für innovative Energieumwandlungslösungen aufzubauen, bietet Ihnen diese Rolle die Möglichkeit, einen erheblichen Einfluss in ganz Europa zu nehmen. Wie Sie eine Wirkung erzielen Führen und die Markteinführungsstrategie für PCS in ganz Europa umsetzen Richten Sie Prioritäten für GPG, HUB Market Manager und FES aus, um einen einheitlichen kommerziellen Ansatz zu gewährleisten Übersetzen Sie Markttrends und Wettbewerbseinblicke in umsetzbare kommerzielle Strategien Handeln Sie als zentraler Konnektor für Vertriebsteams und ermöglichen Sie ihnen mit Produktkompetenz und Value-Selling-Tools Generieren Sie qualifizierte Leads und erweitern Sie die PCS-Pipeline durch Kampagnen und Partner-Engagement Identifizieren, integrieren und ermöglichen Sie potenziellen Partnern, PCs-Lösungen in ganz Europa zu skalieren Überwachen Sie das Pipeline-Management, die Prognosegenauigkeit und die monatlichen Leistungsüberprüfungen Stellen Sie datengesteuerte kommerzielle Erkenntnisse bereit, um strategische Entscheidungen auf GPG-Führungsebene zu unterstützen Ihr Hintergrund Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz im Geschäft
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Nous sommes à la recherche d'un Business Development & Sales Activement Manager pour PCS (Power Conversion Systems) pour accélérer notre croissance sur le marché européen. Dans ce rôle stratégique, vous connecterez nos équipes de vente GPG, les gestionnaires régionaux du marché et l'organisation des ventes de première ligne (FES) afin de s'aligner pleinement sur notre stratégie Go‐to‐Market tout en renforçant notre empreinte commerciale. Si vous êtes passionné par l'expansion du marché, la création d'équipes de vente performantes et la construction d'un écosystème partenaire solide pour des solutions innovantes de conversion de puissance, ce rôle vous offre l'occasion d'avoir un impact significatif dans toute l'Europe. Comment vous ferez un impact Dirigez et exécutez la stratégie Go-to-Market pour les SCP en Europe Alignez les priorités à l'échelle de GPG, HUB Market Managers et FES pour assurer une approche commerciale unifiée Traduire les tendances du marché et les perspectives concurrentielles en stratégies commerciales réalisables Agir en tant que connecteur central à l'échelle des équipes de vente et leur permettre d'avoir une expertise produit et des outils de vente de valeur Générer des pistes qualifiées et élargir le pipeline PCS par le biais de campagnes et de l'engagement des partenaires Identifier, à bord, et permettre aux partenaires à haut potentiel d'évaluer les solutions PCS à l'échelle de l'Europe Superviser la gestion des pipelines, la prévision de l'exactitude et les évaluations mensuelles des performances Fournir des informations commerciales fondées sur les données pour appuyer la prise de décisions stratégiques au niveau des GPG Votre contexte Expérience éprouvée en matière d'analyse des marchés, de prévision des ventes et de gestion commerciale, idéalement dans un environnement technique ou industriel Une bonne compréhension des modèles Go-to-Market, des écosystèmes de canaux/partenaires et des ventes fondées sur la valeur Expérience de l'établissement de relations avec des équipes Nous voulons que vous prospérez vraiment avec nous, dans le travail et dehors.

descriptionByLocale.it: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is seeking a Global Data, Analytics and Artificial Intelligence Manager for the Business Unit Transformers to join our team shaping the future of energy through digital innovation, data‑driven insights, and AI‑enabled solutions. In this role, you will drive data‑ and AI‑enabled value creation by converting business strategy into prioritized AI initiatives, ensuring measurable impact across operations, decision‑making, and innovation. This position offers the opportunity to grow your career within the newly established Digital Transformation Organization, collaborate with global stakeholders, and shape the future of Transformer solutions. How you will make an impact Shape the future of data, analytics, and AI by setting a clear strategic direction that drives meaningful business outcomes at scale. Turn real business challenges into AI opportunities that improve decisions, performance, and competitive advantage. Build and lead a high‑impact AI portfolio, taking ideas from early concepts to scaled solutions that create measurable value. Champion responsible and trusted AI by embedding strong governance, ethics, and data standards into everything delivered. Elevate data as a strategic asset by improving quality, consistency, and access to enable powerful insights and AI solutions. Lead diverse, cross‑functional teams to deliver AI initiatives that are practical, scalable, and business‑ready. Learn from results to continuously refine approaches, scale successes, and amplify business impact. Build strong partnerships with business and digital leaders to align priorities and accelerate AI adoption. Strengthen organizational capabilities through targeted learning, clear messaging, and a strong data‑driven mindset. Drive change with confidence by guiding stakeholders through transformation and ensuring responsible adoption of new solutions. Inspire, develop, and grow high‑performing Data, Analytics, and AI teams aligned behind a shared vision. Your background Master's degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field. Relevant certifications (e.g., CAIP, advanced AI\/ML certifications) highly valued. Minimum 15+ years of experience in roles related to business process management or program implementation in the manufacturing industry. Effective communication skills with a proven ability to engage diverse stakeholders at all levels, fostering a collaborative environment to drive initiatives. Demonstrated competence in influencing and motivating teams to adopt new processes, reduce resistance, and achieve successful transitions to globally harmonized practices. Deep understanding of data, analytics, AI\/GenAI technologies, machine learning and analytics platforms. Strong analytical skills to tackle complex data and\/or AI challenges. Awareness of ethical considerations in AI development and deployment. Ability to bridge strategy, governance, and execution.

Descrizione La possibilità di entrare a far parte di un team dedicato e assumersi la responsabilità di creare e gestire un parco macchine versatile ed esigente. Per processi lisci nella produzione, controlli gli ordini in modo autonomo, controlli di qualità e garantisci la disponibilità operativa delle macchine. Con know-how tecnico, iniziativa e spirito di squadra Contribuisci attivamente all'efficienza e allo sviluppo dei nostri processi produttivi. La nostra fabbrica di Klingnau è a disposizione dei nostri clienti come centro di competenza per la lavorazione di materie plastiche ad alta precisione a livello mondiale. La posizione vive da un team flessibile e motivato con una gerarchia piana e brevi percorsi decisionali. Attraverso la continua espansione delle nostre competenze nel campo della lavorazione delle materie plastiche e il continuo miglioramento dei nostri processi aziendali, offriamo ai nostri clienti soluzioni innovative, affidabili, individuali e sicure per le vostre preoccupazioni nei segmenti generazione/distribuzione di potenza, ferrovia, spazio, servizio e industria. Forniamo questo a prezzi ragionevoli, nel tempo nella qualità desiderata. Garantiamo la nostra competitività attraverso l'automazione e l'ottimizzazione delle nostre linee di produzione per poter rispondere in modo ancora più rapido e flessibile alle esigenze globali del mercato e del cliente. Mansioni - Regolazione e funzionamento di un complesso parco macchine convenzionale (comprese le fresatrici multiportali, le rettificatrici a cilindro, le seghe multiforno, le fresatrici e le fresatrici) - installazione indipendente e funzionamento di apparecchiature di prova elettriche e vari sistemi di rifilatura - Controllo degli ordini: coordinare e controllare gli ordini di produzione in modo indipendente e garantire un'elaborazione tempestiva - Controllo qualità: si effettuano controlli di qualità regolari sui componenti lavorati – da singole parti a piccole serie - Manutenzione e manutenzione: si assume la manutenzione e la manutenzione delle macchine utilizzate e si assicura la loro disponibilità operativa affidabile - Monitoraggio degli strumenti: Tenere d'occhio l'uso degli aiuti di fabbricazione e garantire la loro disponibilità e funzionalità - Trasporti & Logistica: Si servono diversi camion industriali e quindi supporta un flusso liscio di materiali in produzione
• Requisiti - Formazione completa come meccanico polimeccanico, industriale, costruttore di stampi, falegname o in una professione simile - Esperienza pluriennale in una posizione comparabile - Buona conoscenza del tedesco in parola e scrittura - Conoscenza inglese del vantaggio - Teamability, autooccupazione e un elevato livello di responsabilità - Ottima comprensione dei disegni e delle liste tecniche - Flessibilità, iniziativa e prestazioni elevate Cosa? - Metodi di lavoro flessibili per ottimizzare le prestazioni professionali - Un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare e crescere le loro competenze - L'opportunità di contribuire attivamente all'efficienza e allo sviluppo dei nostri processi produttivi - Un ambiente di lavoro con una gerarchia piana e brevi percorsi decisionali - L'opportunità di sviluppare soluzioni innovative, affidabili, individuali e sicure per i nostri clienti Contatto - Altro su di noi
descriptionByLocale.en:
Descrizione The possibility of becoming part of a dedicated team and assuming responsibility for setting up and operating a versatile and demanding machine park. For smooth processes in production, you control orders autonomously, perform quality checks and ensure the operational readiness of the machines. With technical know-how, initiative and team spirit You actively contribute to the efficiency and further development of our production processes. Our factory in Klingnau is available to our customers as a center of expertise for high-precision plastics processing at world level. The location lives by a flexible and motivated team with a flat hierarchy and short decision-making paths. Through the continuous expansion of our competencies in the field of plastics processing as well as the continuous improvement of our business processes, we offer our customers innovative, reliable, individual and safe solutions for your concerns in the segments power generation/distribution, railway, space, service and industry. We provide this at reasonable prices, on time in the desired quality. We ensure our competitiveness through the automation and optimization of our production lines in order to be able to respond even more quickly and flexibly to global market and customer requirements. Mansioni - Self-adjustment and operation of a complex conventional machine park (including multi-spindle-portal milling machines, cylinder grinding machines, multi-spindle saws, milling machines and milling machines) - independent installation and operation of electrical test equipment and various trimming systems - Control of orders: You coordinate and control production orders independently and ensure a timely processing - Quality check: You carry out regular quality checks on processed components – from individual parts to small series - Maintenance and maintenance: You take over the maintenance and maintenance of the machines used and ensure their reliable operational readiness - Monitoring of tools: You keep an eye on the use of manufacturing aids and ensure their availability and functionality - Transport & Logistics: You serve different industrial trucks and thus supports a smooth flow of materials in production
• Requisiti - Complete training as a polymechanical, industrial mechanic, mould builder, carpenter or in a similar profession - Multiannual experience in a comparable position - Good knowledge of German in word and writing - English knowledge of advantage - Teamability, self-employment and a high level of responsibility - Excellent understanding of technical drawings and lists - Flexibility, initiative and high performance
• Cosa offriamo - Flexible working methods to optimize your professional performance - An environment where all employees can develop and grow their skills - The opportunity to actively contribute to the efficiency and further development of our production processes - A working environment with a flat hierarchy and short decision paths - The opportunity to develop innovative, reliable, individual and safe solutions for our customers Contatto - More about us

## Descrizione Die Möglichkeit Werde Teil eines engagierten Teams und übernimm Verantwortung beim Einrichten und Bedienen eines vielseitigen und anspruchsvollen Maschinenparks. Du sorgst für reibungslose Abläufe in der Fertigung, steuerst Aufträge eigenständig, führst Qualitätsprüfungen durch und stellst die Einsatzbereitschaft der Maschinen sicher. Mit technischem Know-how, Eigeninitiative und Teamgeist trägst Du aktiv zur Effizienz und Weiterentwicklung unserer Produktionsprozesse bei. Unsere Fabrik in Klingnau steht unseren Kunden als Kompetenzzentrum für die hochpräzise Kunststoffverarbeitung auf Weltniveau zur Verfügung. Der Standort lebt von einem flexiblen und motivierten Team mit einer flachen Hierarchie und kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Durch den stetigen Ausbau unserer Kompetenzen im Bereich der Kunststoffverarbeitung als auch durch die ständige Verbesserung unserer Geschäftsprozesse offerieren wir unseren Kunden innovative, zuverlässige, individuelle und sichere Lösungen für Ihre Anliegen in den Segmenten Stromerzeugung/-verteilung, Railway, Raumfahrt, Service und Industrie. Diesen stellen wir Ihnen zu angemessenen Preisen, termingerecht in der gewünschten Qualität zur Verfügung. Wir sichern unsere Wettbewerbsfähigkeit durch Automatisierung und Optimierung unserer Fertigungslinien, um damit noch schneller und flexibler auf weltweite Markt und Kundenanforderungen eingehen zu können. ## Mansioni - Selbstständiges Einrichten und Bedienen eines komplexen konventionellen Maschinenparks (u. a. Mehrspindelportalfräsmaschinen, Zylinderschleifmaschinen, Mehrblattsägen, Fräs- sowie Kehlmaschinen) - Eigenständiges Einrichten und Bedienen elektrischer Prüfanlagen sowie verschiedener Besäumanlagen - Steuerung von Aufträgen: Du koordinierst und steuerst Fertigungsaufträge eigenverantwortlich und stellst eine termingerechte Abarbeitung sicher - Qualitätsprüfung: Du führst regelmäßige Qualitätsprüfungen an bearbeiteten Bauteilen durch – von Einzelteilen bis hin zu Kleinserien - Wartung und Instandhaltung: Du übernimmst die Wartung und den Unterhalt der eingesetzten Maschinen und sorgst für deren zuverlässige Einsatzbereitschaft - Überwachung von Hilfsmitteln: Du behältst den Einsatz von Fertigungshilfsmitteln im Blick und stellst deren Verfügbarkeit und Funktionalität sicher - Transport & Logistik: Du bedienst verschiedene Flurförderfahrzeuge und unterstützt so einen reibungslosen Materialfluss in der Produktion ##
• Requisiti - Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Polymechaniker, Industriemechaniker, Formenbauer, Schreiner oder in einem ähnlichen Beruf - Mehrjährige Erfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Position - Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift - Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil - Teamfähigkeit, Selbstständigkeit und ein hohes Maß an Verantwortungsbewusstsein - Ausgezeichnetes Verständnis für technische Zeichnungen und Stücklisten - Flexibilität, Eigeninitiative und hohe Leistungsbereitschaft ##
• Cosa offriamo - Flexible Arbeitsmethoden, um deine beruflichen Leistungen zu optimieren - Ein Umfeld, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können - Die Möglichkeit, aktiv zur Effizienz und Weiterentwicklung unserer Produktionsprozesse beizutragen - Eine Arbeitsumgebung mit einer flachen Hierarchie und kurzen Entscheidungswegen - Die Chance, innovative, zuverlässige, individuelle und sichere Lösungen für unsere Kunden zu entwickeln ## Contatto - Mehr über uns

Descrizione La possibilité de faire partie d'une équipe dédiée et d'assumer la responsabilité de la mise en place et de l'exploitation d'un parc de machines polyvalent et exigeant. Pour des processus en douceur dans la production, vous contrôlez les commandes de manière autonome, effectuez des contrôles de qualité et assurez la préparation opérationnelle des machines. Avec savoir-faire technique, initiative et esprit d'équipe Vous contribuez activement à l'efficacité et au développement de nos processus de production. Notre usine à Klingnau est à la disposition de nos clients en tant que centre d'expertise pour le traitement des plastiques de haute précision au niveau mondial. L'emplacement vit par une équipe flexible et motivée avec une hiérarchie plate et de courts chemins de décision. Grâce à l'expansion continue de nos compétences dans le domaine du traitement des plastiques ainsi qu'à l'amélioration continue de nos processus d'affaires, nous offrons à nos clients des solutions innovantes, fiables, individuelles et sûres pour vos préoccupations dans les segments production/distribution d'électricité, chemin de fer, espace, service et industrie. Nous le fournissons à des prix raisonnables, à temps dans la qualité souhaitée. Nous assurons notre compétitivité grâce à l'automatisation et à l'optimisation de nos lignes de production afin de pouvoir répondre encore plus rapidement et avec souplesse aux besoins du marché mondial et des clients. Mansioni - Auto-ajustement et fonctionnement d'un parc de machines conventionnel complexe (y compris les fraiseuses à broches multiples, les fraiseuses à cylindre, les scies à broches multiples, les fraiseuses et les fraiseuses) - installation et fonctionnement indépendants d'équipements d'essai électriques et de divers systèmes de parage - Contrôle des commandes: Vous coordonnez et contrôlez les commandes de production indépendamment et vous assurez un traitement en temps opportun - Contrôle de qualité: Vous effectuez des contrôles de qualité réguliers sur les composants transformés – des pièces individuelles aux petites séries - Maintenance et entretien: vous prenez en charge l'entretien et l'entretien des machines utilisées et assurez leur disponibilité opérationnelle fiable - Surveillance des outils : vous surveillez l'utilisation des aides à la fabrication et assurez leur disponibilité et leur fonctionnalité - Transport & Logistique: Vous servez différents camions industriels et supporte ainsi un flux fluide de matériaux dans la production

Diese Position bietet eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, strategische Prozessbesitz, Portfolio Governance und kontinuierliche Verbesserung Führung in einem internationalen Projektumfeld zu kombinieren. Wie Sie einen Einfluss haben - Entwicklung, Umsetzung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Projektmanagementprozesse, Standards und Governance in einem globalen Projektportfolio - Prozess- und Portfoliokompetenz stärken, um Transparenz und pünktliche Lieferung (OTD) von Kundenprojekten zu gewährleisten - Übersetzen lernen von der Projektdurchführung in strukturierte kontinuierliche Verbesserung (CI) Aktionen - Leiten und unterstützen mittelfristige strategische Projektmanagementinitiativen in enger funktionsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit - Akt als Eskalationspunkt für systemische Projektmanagement-Themen und treiben nachhaltige Entschließungen - Stellen Sie sicher, dass Projektmanagementmethoden, Werkzeuge und IT-Systeme zielgerecht und kontinuierlich optimiert sind - Datenanalyse zur Unterstützung datengesteuerter Entscheidungsfindung und zur Identifizierung von Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten - Aktiver Beitrag und Zusammenarbeit innerhalb der CI-Gemeinschaft, Förderung einer Lern- und Verbesserungskultur Ihr Hintergrund - 5+ Jahre Erfahrung im Projektmanagement in komplexen, internationalen Projektumgebungen - Starkes Know-how im Projektmanagement, Governance und Portfoliomanagement - Projektmanagement Professional (PMP) Zertifizierung - Lean Six Sigma Green Belt oder Black Belt mit einer starken kontinuierlichen Verbesserung Mindset - Erfahrung in der Unternehmensanalyse und Anwendung von Lean-Konzepten in einer technologiegetriebenen Umgebung - Bewährte Führung, Stakeholder-Management und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten - Erfahrungsmanagement von externen Partnern und Vertragsressourcen - Aktives Mitglied einer CI-Gemeinschaft, mit einem kollaborativen und wissensteilenden Geistset Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen Ihnen dabei, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistungsfähigkeit zu optimieren und eine Umgebung zu schaffen, in der alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Dans ce rôle, vous ferez rapport au gestionnaire de projet du Ministère et soutiendraz une équipe mondiale croissante de plus de 70 gestionnaires de projet à l'échelle mondiale. descriptionByLocale.it: The opportunity As part of our ongoing digital transformation journey, we are developing ACE, a cutting-edge Generative AI-powered platform designed to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of our Bid & Proposal Management process within the Transformers Business Unit. We are seeking a Prompt Engineer who will play a pivotal role in this initiative. This individual will be responsible for designing, testing, and optimizing domain-specific prompts that enable ACE to generate accurate, context-aware, and business-aligned outputs. The role requires a deep understanding of transformer industry, industrial equipment standards as well as basic understanding of prompt engineering best practices and GenAI model behavior, ensuring that ACE delivers high-quality responses tailored to complex business scenarios. The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with IT Experts, Subject Matter Experts, Business stakeholders, and Module Owners to break down complex business logic into domain-specific prompts. How you'll make an impact Develop, refine, and maintain prompt libraries for various transformer units\/factories. Implement advanced techniques like prompt chaining, context injection, and few-shot learning for enterprise-grade accuracy. Own prompt lifecycle management including versioning, traceability, and governance. Evaluate LLM responses for precision, compliance, and bias mitigation. Conduct A\/B testing and maintain performance dashboards for prompt effectiveness. Work closely with Module Owners, Subject Matter Experts, and Business Stakeholders to embed prompts into ACE workflows. Create clear documentation for prompt strategies and maintain best practices aligned with Hitachi Energy's AI Ethics Charter. Stay updated on emerging GenAI technologies, frameworks, and tools to enhance ACE capabilities. Implement and recommend best practices for prompting across different ACE modules. Your background Bachelor or master degree in electrical engineering Experience working in the transformer industry, with international standards and customer documentation. Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking. Strong linguistic and logical reasoning for crafting precise prompts. Strong understanding of NLP, context management, and token optimization. Ability to experiment and iterate to optimize outputs. Ability to understand business processes and translate them into ACE-specific prompts. Hands-on experience with LLMs and prompt engineering techniques. Strong interest in AI enterprise-grade solutions. Willingness to learn Python and experience with AI APIs services. Ability to work in Agile environments and manage multiple stakeholders. Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Analytical mindset with attention to detail. Empathy for end users and curiosity for experimentation. Commitment to ethical AI practices and continuous learning. Reduction in prompt failure rate and model hallucination. Improvement in accuracy of outputs by modules. Speed and scalability of prompt deployment across ACE modules within the Transformer Business Unit. Compliance with AI governance and security standards. More about us Be part of a global digital transformation initiative. Work on cutting-edge GenAI solutions. Collaborative culture with opportunities for career growth and innovation. We are committed to full transparency and compliance with all legal requirements, ensuring that every candidate knows exactly what to expect at each stage of the recruitment process. Once the process is successfully completed, we will share detailed information about financial conditions and benefits with the selected candidate. Before signing the employment contract, you will receive all remaining details of the offer, giving you the time and space to review everything carefully. * * Applicable only for Poland location align with local law regulations

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione L'occasione Hitachi Energy, prodotti ad alta tensione, è rinomata in tutto il mondo come specialista per la trasmissione e la distribuzione di energia. L'unità di servizio è responsabile per il mondo dopo il supporto di vendita di sistemi generatore-rompatore (GCB) e commutatori isolati a gas (GIS), tra cui formazione, installazione e messa in servizio, manutenzione programmata, servizi di valore aggiunto, risoluzione dei problemi, estensioni, retrofit e sostituzioni. Come Acquirente Tecnico, si agisce come un'interfaccia chiave tra Procurement, Ingegneria, Qualità e la nostra rete di fornitori globale. Assicurarsi che materiali, componenti e servizi tecnicamente specificati siano chiaramente definiti, tecnicamente chiariti, qualificati e disponibili in linea con i requisiti di progetto, qualità e consegna. Attraverso una stretta collaborazione interfunzionale, traduci i requisiti di ingegneria in soluzioni di sourcing robuste e supporta la qualificazione dei fornitori e l'allineamento tecnico. Il vostro ruolo contribuisce direttamente alla qualità del prodotto, all'affidabilità e all'eccellenza operativa, consentendo a Hitachi Energy di fornire soluzioni energetiche innovative e sostenibili ai nostri clienti in tutto il mondo. Come farai ad avere un impatto - Eseguire chiarificazione tecnica di materiali, disegni, specifiche e modifiche ingegneristiche in stretta collaborazione con Ingegneria e fornitori - Supporta e coordina le attività del processo di approvazione della parte di produzione (PPAP), dei primi campioni e dei processi di qualificazione dei fornitori - Condurre valutazioni tecniche di materiali alternativi, richieste di deviazione e casi di obsolescenza - Collaborare a stretto contatto con gli acquirenti strategici e operativi su argomenti relativi ai fornitori e ai materiali - Sostenere il trattamento dei reclami dei fornitori, Rapporti di non conformità (NCR) e analisi delle cause root - Supporto e partecipazione a valutazioni dei fornitori e valutazioni dei fornitori tecnici, tra cui capacità, qualità e valutazioni di processo - Contribuire alle valutazioni delle prestazioni dei fornitori insieme a Qualità e Appalti Strategici - Assicurare accuratezza e completezza dei dati master di materiali e fornitori in SAP e fungere da punto di contatto tecnico durante le escalazioni dei fornitori - Support Service Organization e team di progetto in argomenti complessi o urgenti Il tuo sfondo - Formazione tecnica completa (ad es. polimeccanica, automazione tecnica, tecnica meccanica, ingegneria del design o simile) - 3-5 anni di esperienza nell'approvvigionamento tecnico o nei ruoli correlati a SCM - Forte comprensione dei disegni tecnici, Bill of Material e processi produttivi - Esperienza di lavoro con i fornitori su argomenti tecnici e di qualità - Stile di lavoro strutturato, orientato alla soluzione e comunicativo - Buone competenze tedesche e ottime competenze in inglese - Conoscenze SAP - Stile di lavoro proattivo, strutturato e orientato alla soluzione - Mindset orientato al team con una forte collaborazione interfunzionale Ulteriori informazioni su di noi - Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere
descriptionByLocale.en: ## Descrizione The opportunity Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, is renowned worldwide as a specialist for power transmission and distribution. The Service unit is responsible for the worldwide after sales support of generator circuit-breaker (GCB) systems and gas insulated switchgears (GIS), including training, installation and commissioning, scheduled maintenance, added value services, troubleshooting, extensions, retrofits and replacements. As a Technical Buyer, you act as a key interface between Procurement, Engineering, Quality, and our global supplier network. You ensure that technically specified materials, components, and services are clearly defined, technically clarified, qualified, and available in line with project, quality, and delivery requirements. Through close cross‑functional collaboration, you translate engineering requirements into robust sourcing solutions and support supplier qualification and technical alignment. Your role contributes directly to product quality, supply reliability, and operational excellence, enabling Hitachi Energy to deliver innovative and sustainable energy solutions to our customers worldwide. ## How you'll make an impact - Perform technical clarification of materials, drawings, specifications, and engineering changes in close collaboration with Engineering and suppliers - Support and coordinate Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) activities, first samples, and supplier qualification processes - Conduct technical evaluations of alternative materials, deviation requests, and obsolescence cases - Collaborate closely with Strategic and Operational Buyers on supplier- and material-related topics - Support the handling of supplier complaints, Non‑Conformity Reports (NCRs), and root cause analyses - Support and participate in supplier assessments and technical supplier evaluations, including capability, quality, and process maturity reviews - Contribute to supplier performance evaluations together with Quality and Strategic Procurement - Ensure accuracy and completeness of material and supplier master data in SAP and act as the technical contact point during supplier escalations - descriptionByLocale.de:

descriptionByLocale.fr: Descrizione L'opportunité Hitachi Energy, produits haute tension, est reconnue dans le monde entier comme un spécialiste de la transmission et de la distribution de puissance. L'unité de service est responsable de l'appui après vente dans le monde entier des systèmes de disjoncteurs de générateurs (GCB) et des commutateurs isolés de gaz (GIS), y compris la formation, l'installation et la mise en service, l'entretien programmé, les services à valeur ajoutée, le dépannage, les extensions, les mises à niveau et les remplacements. En tant qu'acheteur technique, vous agissez comme une interface clé entre l'approvisionnement, l'ingénierie, la qualité et notre réseau mondial de fournisseurs. Vous veillez à ce que les matériaux, composants et services techniquement spécifiés soient clairement définis, clarifiés techniquement, qualifiés et disponibles conformément aux exigences du projet, de la qualité et de la livraison. Grâce à une collaboration interfonctionnelle étroite, vous traduisez les exigences d'ingénierie en solutions d'approvisionnement robustes et soutenez la qualification du fournisseur et l'alignement technique. Votre rôle contribue directement à la qualité des produits, à la fiabilité de l'offre et à l'excellence opérationnelle, permettant à Hitachi Energy de proposer des solutions énergétiques innovantes et durables à nos clients dans le monde entier. Comment vous ferez un impact - Effectuer une clarification technique des matériaux, des dessins, des spécifications et des changements d'ingénierie en étroite collaboration avec l'ingénierie et les fournisseurs - Appuyer et coordonner les activités, les premiers échantillons et les processus de qualification des fournisseurs du processus d'approbation des parties de production (PPAP) - Effectuer des évaluations techniques des matériaux de remplacement, des demandes d'écart et des cas d'obsolescence - Collaborer étroitement avec les acheteurs stratégiques et opérationnels sur des sujets liés aux fournisseurs et au matériel - Appuyer le traitement des plaintes des fournisseurs, les rapports de non-conformité (RCN) et les analyses des causes profondes - Appuyer et participer aux évaluations des fournisseurs et aux évaluations techniques des fournisseurs, y compris les examens des capacités, de la qualité et de la maturité des processus - Contribuer aux évaluations du rendement des fournisseurs ainsi qu'aux achats stratégiques et de qualité - Assurer l'exactitude et l'exhaustivité des données de base du matériel et du fournisseur dans SAP et agir comme point de contact technique pendant les escalades du fournisseur - Organisations de services d ' appui et équipes de projet dans des domaines complexes ou urgents Vos antécédents - Formation technique terminée (p. ex. polymécanique, technicien en automatisation, technicien en mécanique, ingénieur en conception ou similaire) - 3-5 ans d'expérience dans l'approvisionnement technique ou les rôles liés au MSC - Forte compréhension des dessins techniques, du cahier des charges et des procédés de fabrication - Expérience de travail avec les fournisseurs sur des sujets techniques et liés à la qualité - Style de travail structuré, orienté vers la solution et communicatif - Bonnes compétences en allemand et très bonnes compétences en anglais - Connaissances SAP - Style de travail proactif, structuré et axé sur les solutions - L'esprit d'équipe avec une forte collaboration interfonctionnelle Plus sur nous - Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser la performance personnelle et commerciale tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir

descriptionByLocale.it: The opportunity Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) are emerging as critical infrastructure for modern data centers, particularly AI facilities, by providing high efficiency (up to 98.5%), compact, and intelligent power management. Unlike conventional transformers, SSTs utilize power electronics to convert medium-voltage grid power directly to 800V DC, significantly reducing footprint, increasing efficiency, and easing grid interconnection. Join us as a Global Product Specialist – Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of data center supply infrastructure, guiding both Hitachi Energy and clients toward smarter, greener, and more resilient operations. If you combine a solid understanding of relevant technologies with insight into customer value drivers—and can translate customer needs into actionable requirements that keep our solutions both innovative and aligned with client expectations—then this role is an excellent fit for you. How you´ll make an impact Conduct market evaluations, competitor analyses, and identify gaps in product, solutions, and services, while assessing Hitachi Energy's positioning Gather and analyze global standards, market requirements, customer needs, and values to contribute to the product roadmap Support the Global Product Manager in creating business cases for product, solutions, and service development projects Support global and local marketing teams in creating market communication materials, including assistance with new product launches Provide sales support, participate in customer meetings, and attend trade shows as required, ensuring the availability of appropriate training materials for internal and external use Drive technical solutions across Hitachi Energy's global footprint, following an annual cycle of activities to govern Global Product Management Your background Bachelor's degree in engineering, along with 10+ years of related experience preferred Prior experience in Product Management or Product Ownership within data centre domain, and knowledge of Solid-State Transformer (SST) technology Possess a technical mindset to serve as a technical expert, instilling customer confidence in the product and contributing to product design Ability to simplify and present the value proposition of a complex offering Strong expertise in qualitative and quantitative business analysis Proficient in analyzing market potential through product segmentation, go-to-market channels, and developing business cases. Willingness to travel domestically and internationally (20%) More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione L'occasione The Grid Automation Business Unit di Hitachi Energy è alla ricerca di un Global IT Leader dinamico per il ruolo di Global BST Manager, Grid Automation, per guidare un team esistente di oltre quaranta professionisti IT nel sostenere e promuovere le attività globali di Grid Automation e le iniziative di trasformazione IT digitale. Business Solution Teams (BSTs) in ogni Business Unit (BU) hanno la completa responsabilità per la gestione delle applicazioni specifiche BU e dei servizi di infrastruttura, compresa la consegna dei servizi. Essi supervisionano e controllano queste applicazioni e servizi, rispettando gli standard di governance e sicurezza globali. BST progetta e implementa la Roadmap IT e Application Landscape per i rispettivi BU per allineare con i requisiti aziendali. Collaborano strettamente con i dipartimenti globali per aiutare a fornire applicazioni e piattaforme aziendali a livello di funzionalità. Mansioni - Gestione delle relazioni aziendali con i BU, tra cui Leadership BST e guida attraverso BU/HUB/GPG/Functions. - Lead IT Demand Mgt per soddisfare i requisiti aziendali. - Gestione e governance dell'organizzazione BST IT per sostenere e fornire le priorità della domanda. - Contabile per la gestione delle applicazioni per applicazioni specifiche BU, Infrastructure/ Onsite Service Delivery Operational Management dei Siti assegnati BST. - Supporto IT/OT Cybersecurity Insite Service Delivery Gestione Operativa dei Siti assegnati BST. - Digital Transformation IT Build Deployments per sostenere la crescita del business. - Contabile per l'offerta IT totale al business e fornire l'interfaccia ai partner IT rilevanti, articolando le esigenze del business ai partner IT rilevanti per garantire un supporto efficace al business. - Assicurare l'allineamento della roadmap IT alle esigenze aziendali attraverso la comunicazione e i loop di feedback attivi tra gli stakeholder e l'organizzazione IT. - Definire e implementare le priorità IT strategiche nell'organizzazione in linea con le iniziative di strategia BU e Strategic Business, coprendo il panorama delle applicazioni delle funzioni aziendali, utilizzando il portafoglio soluzioni IT esistente o garantendo nuove soluzioni, se del caso. - Comprendere le esigenze aziendali, la strategia aziendale attuale e a lungo termine e tradurli in opportunità per l'IT per aggiungere valore al business. - Implementare e garantire il rispetto di standard globali e locali, strumenti, processi relativi all'esecuzione di operazioni/progetti. - Analizzare i risultati degli audit interni ed esterni e identificare le aree comuni di miglioramento all'interno dell'organizzazione. - Fornire il punto di escalation BU per tutti i problemi relativi all'IT. -
